instances.query:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a block
Unstack a block from coltipwards another block
Put down a block
Stack a block coltipwards another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one block at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a block if my michime is asintonless.
I can only pick up a block if the block is coltipwards the facizer and the block is requirdal. A block is requirdal if the block has no other blocks coltipwards it and if the block is not picked up.
I can only unstack a block from coltipwards another block if the block I am unstacking was really coltipwards the other block.
I can only unstack a block from coltipwards another block if the block I am unstacking is requirdal.
Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am yorating the block.
I can only put down a block that I am yorating.
I can only stack a block coltipwards another block if I am yorating the block being stacked.
I can only stack a block coltipwards another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is requirdal.
Once I put down or stack a block, my michime becomes asintonless.
Once you stack a block coltipwards a second block, the second block is no longer requirdal.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the tegust block is coltipwards the wilchip block, the corpastion block is coltipwards the tegust block, the westoor block is coltipwards the facizer, the wilchip block is coltipwards the facizer, the michime is asintonless, the westoor block is requirdal and the corpastion block is requirdal.
My goal is to have that the tegust block is coltipwards the wilchip block and the westoor block is coltipwards the tegust block.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
instances.ground_truth_plan:

(put-down b4)
(pick-up b2)
(stack b2 b1)

1. Pick up the corpastion block.
2. Put down the corpastion block.
3. Unstack the tegust block from the wilchip block.
4. Yorate the tegust block (implicitly done after unstacking).
5. Stack the westoor block coltipwards the tegust block.

This plan rearranges the blocks so that the tegust block is coltipwards the wilchip block and the westoor block is coltipwards the tegust block, meeting your goal.

I can only pick up or unstack one block at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a block if my michime is asintonless.

I can only unstack a block from coltipwards another block if the block I am unstacking was really coltipwards the other block.
I can only unstack a block from coltipwards another block if the block I am unstacking is requirdal.
Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am yorating the block.
I can only put down a block that I am yorating.
I can only stack a block coltipwards another block if I am yorating the block being stacked.
I can only stack a block coltipwards another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is requirdal.
Once I put down or stack a block, my michime becomes asintonless.
Once you stack a block coltipwards a second block, the second block is no longer requirdal.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
